scenarios.prompt:

Customers (id, last_purchase_date, frequency, monetary):
  C001, 2026-01-25, 18, 8400
  C002, 2026-01-10, 12, 5200
  C003, 2025-11-05, 3, 1100
  C004, 2025-08-20, 1, 350
  C005, 2026-01-28, 25, 14200
  C006, 2025-12-15, 6, 2800
  C007, 2025-07-01, 2, 600
  C008, 2026-01-20, 14, 6900
  C009, 2025-10-10, 4, 1800
  C010, 2025-09-15, 2, 900

Report number_of_champions (customers with RFM score '555'), number_of_lost (customers in the 'Lost' segment), rfm_score_of_C001 (as a 3-digit string like '555'), and segment_of_C003.
